chunks: And the Scholar, peace be upon him, said:
"There are three matters in which I do not practice taqiyyah with anyone: drinking intoxicants, wiping over the khuffs, and Hajj al-Tamattu'."

key_terms.أَتَّقِي: I practice taqiyyah; I act with precautionary dissimulation
key_terms.الْخُفَّيْنِ: the two leather socks or khuffs
key_terms.الْعَالِمُ: the Imam referred to as the learned authority
key_terms.مُتْعَةُ: tamattu'; the specific form of hajj combination

ai.seo_question: Which legal matters did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say he would not conceal through taqiyyah?
ai.summary: This hadith states that there are three matters in which the Imam عليه السلام does not practice taqiyyah: the prohibition of intoxicants, the issue of wiping over the khuffs, and Mut'at al-Hajj. It highlights these as clear legal matters of significance in Shia fiqh.
